design.cost: reserves one turn from the existing hourly chat budget (30/h in production); 429 with reset time when exhausted
design.grounding: retrieves published guides through the same MCP search function, then asks the configured model to answer only from those rows and cite them; sources are returned separately and linked to /g/{id}
design.fallback: if the model is unconfigured or fails, returns a plain catalogue result labelled “Catalogue result (model not configured)”
design.retrievalFix: catalogue search matches substrings, not questions; when the full question returns nothing the endpoint searches its meaningful words and merges by guide id (caught by acceptance)

production.question: Which guide is good for a family trip to Singapore?
production.answer: The guide for a family trip to Singapore is “Singapore with kids: the stroller-friendly route.” …

honestLimits: The answer is generated and can still misstate details; the source cards are the verifiable part.
Signed-in only to bound cost; no anonymous assistant.
No conversation memory or history: each question is independent and nothing is stored.
No booking/charge/availability action: it explicitly cannot book or confirm.
The 30/h budget is shared with the studio chat assistant for that account.
